name: Given a user has a valid subscription plan, When the user initiates a subscription, Then the subscription should start successfully and navigated back to the app to see subscription successful popup page
Given a user's program has no plans assigned, When the programEnd_date is breached (days_until_payment_due=-1), Then the user should still have access to all features
Given subscription plans are created from the coach portal, When the user fetches the subscription plans list, Then the correct subscription plans should be displayed
Given a user's program has plans assigned, When the programEnd_date is breached (days_until_payment_due=-1), Then the user should be blocked from accessing features
Given a user has subscribed to the plan, When the user tries to access the application, Then the user should not be blocked and should have full access
Given a user has no active subscription, When the subscription list is fetched, Then the subscription list should be empty
Given user's cohort programDate is updated, When there are 7 days left in the program, Then the paywall banner should be validated successfully
